slug: 2026-05-22 Why global hyperscalers are avoiding Nigeria despite Africa's biggest market

facts.fact: The article says the telecom sector still operates largely under telecommunications policies designed more than 25 years ago, with the National Telecommunications Policy not rewritten since 2000.

The federal government is moving to rewrite the National Telecommunications Policy; an NCC review workshop in Lagos, ongoing at the article's publication date of 2026-05-22, was to produce recommendations for a new policy.

The NCC held a telecommunications policy review workshop (dated by the article's publication, 2026-05-22) with regulators, operators and investors, opening the first rewrite of the National Telecommunications Policy since 2000.

systems.owner: Federal government; NCC convening the review
